newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto names general as information minister.
newsitem.headline: Suharto names general as information minister.

text.p: President Suharto has appointed retiring army chief of staff Lieutenant-General Hartono as Indonesia's new information minister, State Secretary Murdiono said on Friday.
He said Suharto had named Lieutenant-General Wiranto, currently head of the army's strategic command, as the new chief of staff.

The previous information minister, Harmoko, was made minister for special affairs. He retains his position as general chairman of the ruling Golkar party, which won a sweeping general election victory last week.
Murdiono said an installation ceremony would be held next Wednesday.
Hartono was due to reach his mandatory extended retirement age in the army next Tuesday.
